question: What services are included?
actualResponse: Hello. Our Jetour vehicles come with a comprehensive service plan and warranty to ensure your peace of mind.Could you please let me know which model you are interested in so I can provide the specific details for you?

question: Is roadside assistance available 24/7?
actualResponse: Yes, our roadside assistance is available 24/7 to support you.To ensure I can assist you properly if you need help, could you please provide your full name?

question: How do I request assistance?
actualResponse: To request roadside assistance, please provide me with your full name, vehicle make and model, registration number, and your current location. Once I have these details, I can provide the emergency contact information to get you the help you need.

question: Who is covered under my plan?
actualResponse: Your service plan and roadside assistance cover the Jetour vehicle itself, regardless of who is driving it at the time.To ensure I have your details on file for any future support, may I please have your full name?

question: Does coverage apply to rental cars?
actualResponse: Our service plan and roadside assistance are specific to the Jetour vehicle registered in our system and do not extend to rental cars.To help me update your records, could you please share your full name?
